_comment: Story catalog. Placeholders: {hero} = child's name; {c1}..{c5} = family members in upload order ({c1} falls back to the story's sidekick when no family photo was added); {family} = everyone added, as a list; {their}/{them}/{Their} = hero pronouns. Captions may only use {hero}, {c1}, {family} and pronouns; speech lines and cast entries for c2..c5 are dropped automatically when that person wasn't added. 'scene' is the illustration brief sent to the image model (never shown to readers). 'category' must be one of the ids in 'categories' (used for the catalogue's theme filter).

ageGroups.name: Tiny Tots
ageGroups.blurb: One big picture per page, a few warm words, lots of familiar faces.

ageGroups.name: Little Explorers
ageGroups.blurb: Short read-aloud adventures with two comic panels per page.

ageGroups.name: Young Heroes
ageGroups.blurb: Real comic layouts, speech bubbles and a proper adventure plot.

ageGroups.name: Super Readers
ageGroups.blurb: Longer stories with twists, puzzles and more to read on every page.

stories.title: {hero}'s Big Day
stories.blurb: From wake-up cuddles to bedtime kisses — a gentle day with the people who love your little one most.

panels.scene: a cosy sunny bedroom in the morning, the child waking up and stretching in a cot
panels.caption: Good morning, {hero}!

panels.scene: a bright kitchen, the child at breakfast with a smiling family member
panels.caption: Breakfast with {c1}. Yum, yum!

panels.scene: a sunny park with green grass, a swing and ducks by a pond
panels.caption: Off to the park! Wheee!

panels.scene: a bath with lots of bubbles and a rubber duck
panels.caption: Splish, splash, bubble bath!

panels.scene: a warm living room, the whole family hugging together on a sofa
panels.caption: Big hugs from {family}.

panels.scene: a quiet night bedroom with a moon outside the window, the child sleeping peacefully
panels.caption: Goodnight, {hero}. Sweet dreams!

stories.title: Who Loves {hero}?
stories.blurb: A peek-a-boo style book where every page reveals someone special. Perfect for showing off up to five family members.

panels.scene: the child peeking out from behind a soft blanket, playful
panels.caption: Who loves {hero}? Let's find out!

panels.scene: a family member lifting the child up high in a sunny garden, both laughing
panels.caption: {c1} loves {hero}!

panels.scene: a family member reading a picture book to the child
panels.caption: Everyone loves story time.

panels.scene: a family member playing with blocks with the child on a rug
panels.caption: Build it up... and BOOM!

panels.scene: family members dancing with the child in a living room with music notes
panels.caption: Dance, dance, dance!

panels.scene: the whole family together in a big group hug, hearts floating around
panels.caption: So many people love {hero}. Hooray!

stories.title: {hero} and the Missing Moon
stories.blurb: The moon has vanished from the night sky! Only one brave astronaut can find it and bring it home.

sidekick.name: Zippy
sidekick.desc: a small friendly silver robot with round blue eyes

panels.scene: a child's bedroom at night, looking out of a window at a dark sky with stars but no moon
panels.caption: One night, {hero} looked up at the sky. Something was missing!

panels.scene: a cardboard-box rocket in a back garden transforming into a real shiny rocket, a friend beside the child
panels.caption: {hero} and {c1} built a rocket from a very big box.

panels.scene: a small rocket blasting off into space past clouds and stars
panels.caption: 3... 2... 1... BLAST OFF!

panels.scene: a ringed planet with friendly smiling aliens waving at the astronaut child
panels.caption: They met some friendly aliens on Planet Wobble.

panels.scene: the moon hiding behind a big fluffy space cloud, looking shy and sad
panels.caption: At last they found the moon, hiding and feeling shy.

speech.text: Don't be sad, Moon. We need your light!

panels.scene: the child hugging the glowing moon in space, stars sparkling all around
panels.caption: {hero} gave the moon a great big hug. The moon began to glow!

panels.scene: the rocket flying home with the full moon shining back in the night sky over a house
panels.caption: Back home, the moon shone brighter than ever — just for {hero}.

stories.title: {hero}'s Dino Picnic
stories.blurb: A picnic basket, a magic gate and a valley full of friendly dinosaurs who've never tasted a sandwich.

panels.scene: a family packing a picnic basket in a sunny kitchen
panels.caption: {hero} packed the biggest picnic ever.

panels.scene: a mysterious glowing gate covered in vines at the end of a garden
panels.caption: At the end of the garden, a gate began to glow.

panels.scene: a lush prehistoric valley with volcanoes far away and friendly long-necked dinosaurs
panels.caption: Dino Valley! A long-necked dinosaur said hello.

panels.scene: a baby triceratops sniffing a picnic sandwich curiously
panels.caption: A baby dino had never seen a sandwich before.

panels.scene: children and dinosaurs having a big picnic on a checkered blanket
panels.caption: Soon everyone was sharing the picnic — dinos too!

panels.scene: the child waving goodbye to the dinosaurs at the glowing gate at sunset
panels.caption: Time to go home. {hero} promised to come back next Sunday.

speech.text: Bye, dinos! Save me a seat!

stories.title: {hero} and the Festival of Lights
stories.blurb: The diyas won't light on festival night! {hero} sets off on a glowing adventure to bring the sparkle back.

panels.scene: a home decorated with rangoli and marigold garlands on festival evening, family getting ready
panels.caption: It was festival night! {hero} drew the brightest rangoli.

speech.text: Beautiful! Now let's light the diyas.

panels.scene: clay diya lamps that will not light, a puzzled child holding a matchless lamp
panels.caption: But the diyas would not light. Not even one!

speech.text: Oh no! Where did the sparkle go?

panels.scene: a glowing firefly guiding a child and a companion down a lantern-lit street
panels.caption: A tiny firefly blinked: 'Follow me!'

panels.scene: neighbours sharing sweets and smiling at their doorsteps, laddoos and jalebis
panels.caption: Every time {hero} shared a sweet and a smile, a little light appeared.

panels.scene: the child carrying a jar full of glowing lights back home
panels.caption: Soon {hero} had a whole jar full of sparkle!

panels.scene: a house glowing with hundreds of diyas and fireworks in the sky, the family celebrating together
panels.caption: Every diya glowed. The best light of all was kindness — and {hero} had lots!

stories.title: Captain {hero} Under the Sea
stories.blurb: A yellow submarine, a lost baby whale and a coral reef full of surprises. Dive in, Captain!

panels.scene: a harbour with a shiny yellow mini submarine, the child wearing a captain's hat
panels.caption: Captain {hero} had a brand new submarine and a very important mission.

speech.text: Captain, a baby whale is lost!
Then we dive. Full speed ahead!

panels.scene: the submarine diving down through blue water with schools of fish
panels.caption: Down, down, down they went, past a thousand silver fish.

speech.text: Sonar on! Listen for whale songs.

panels.scene: a colourful coral reef with a grumpy octopus guarding a cave
panels.caption: A grumpy octopus blocked the way.

speech.text: Maybe he just needs a friend?
Hi! I'm {hero}. Can you help us?

panels.scene: the octopus smiling and pointing eight arms towards a deep trench
panels.caption: The octopus smiled and pointed eight arms at once. That way!

panels.scene: a baby whale tangled in an old fishing net in the deep sea, glowing jellyfish around
panels.caption: There it was — the baby whale, tangled in an old net.

panels.scene: a mother whale and the baby whale reunited, the submarine beside them
panels.caption: Mama Whale sang the happiest song the ocean had ever heard.

panels.scene: the submarine surfacing at sunset with dolphins jumping around it
panels.caption: Mission complete. And the ocean was a little cleaner, too.

stories.title: Super {hero} Saves the Day
stories.blurb: When the city's colours start disappearing, a brand-new superhero (with a very familiar face) answers the call.

sidekick.name: Captain Whiskers
sidekick.desc: a brave orange cat wearing a tiny cape

panels.scene: a city skyline where the buildings are slowly turning grey, people looking worried
panels.caption: Something strange was happening. The colours of the city were fading away!

speech.text: This looks like a job for... me!

panels.scene: the child spinning into a superhero costume with a cape and mask in a burst of light
panels.caption: With a spin and a flash, {hero} became SUPER {hero}!

panels.scene: a superhero sidekick appearing on a rooftop ready for action
panels.caption: Every hero needs a partner. {c1} was ready.

speech.text: I've found the clue! Follow the grey trail!

panels.scene: a silly villain with a giant vacuum machine sucking colour out of a rainbow
panels.caption: It was Doctor Dull and his Colour-Sucker 3000!

panels.scene: family members helping, holding paint buckets and brushes, ready to help the superhero
panels.caption: {hero} had a plan — and some very helpful family.

panels.scene: the colour machine exploding into a giant harmless rainbow burst over the city
panels.caption: {hero} flipped the switch to REVERSE. KA-BLOOEY!

panels.scene: a colourful city celebrating the hero, confetti, the villain now smiling and painting too
panels.caption: The city was brighter than ever. Even Doctor Dull wanted to paint!

stories.title: {hero} and the Time-Travel Backpack
stories.blurb: A dusty backpack from the attic has a dial that says 'WHEN?'. Pyramids, castles and a robot future — and a puzzle to solve in each.

sidekick.name: Tock
sidekick.desc: a wise owl wearing tiny round glasses

panels.scene: a dusty attic with old trunks and a glowing backpack with a brass dial
panels.caption: While exploring the attic, {hero} found a backpack with a strange brass dial. It said: WHEN?

panels.scene: ancient Egypt, pyramids under construction, a puzzled builder holding a broken measuring rope
panels.caption: WHOOSH! Egypt, 4,500 years ago. The builders couldn't make their corners square.

speech.text: Tie knots to make a 3-4-5 triangle — perfect right angle every time!

panels.scene: a medieval castle with a drawbridge stuck halfway, knights scratching their heads
panels.caption: WHOOSH! A castle, 800 years ago. The drawbridge was stuck.

speech.text: Then we need a pulley. Less pull, same lift.

panels.scene: a futuristic city with flying cars and a sad robot with a flickering screen
panels.caption: WHOOSH! The year 2300. A robot had forgotten how to be kind.

speech.text: Kindness isn't code. You just say: 'How can I help?'

panels.scene: the backpack dial sparking and spinning wildly, time swirling around the child
panels.caption: Then the dial began spinning out of control!

speech.text: Today's date... and our address. Hold on!

panels.scene: the child back home at the dinner table telling the family about the adventure, family listening amazed
panels.caption: Home in time for dinner. Nobody believed a word of it... until they saw the sand in {their} shoes.

panels.scene: the backpack quietly glowing on the shelf at night, the dial now pointing to a new symbol
panels.caption: That night, the dial clicked by itself to a brand new word: WHERE?

stories.title: {hero} vs. the Runaway Robot
stories.blurb: {hero}'s science-fair robot is a bit too clever — and now it's loose in the school. Time to think like an engineer.

sidekick.name: Byte
sidekick.desc: a clever little robot dog with antenna ears

panels.scene: a messy workshop table covered with wires, gears and a half-built robot, the child wearing safety goggles
panels.caption: The science fair was tomorrow, and {hero}'s robot, BOLT, was nearly finished.

speech.text: Only one way to find out!

panels.scene: a school hall science fair, a cheerful robot zooming away on wheels, papers flying
panels.caption: At the fair, BOLT switched on... and zoomed straight out of the door!

panels.scene: a school corridor with tracks of footprints, the child studying them with a magnifying glass
panels.caption: Engineers don't panic. They collect data.

speech.text: The tracks turn left at every corner.
Its sensor's stuck! It always follows the left wall.

panels.scene: the robot in the school kitchen spinning plates and causing silly chaos
panels.caption: Follow the left wall... straight into the school kitchen!

panels.scene: the child holding a big magnet on a string to attract the robot, teacher and family watching
panels.caption: {hero} built a trap from a magnet, a mop and a string.

speech.text: BOLT's chassis is steel. Physics never lets you down!

panels.scene: the robot calmly back on the science fair table, the child explaining the bug to judges
panels.caption: {hero} fixed the sensor and explained everything to the judges — even the mistake.

speech.text: A bug isn't a failure. It's data!

panels.scene: the child holding a big gold first-prize trophy with the robot waving, family cheering
panels.caption: First prize! And BOLT got a medal for 'Most Enthusiastic Robot'.
